Talent Acquisition Specialist, Orbit Health — Dec 2023 - Present

I also configured workflows in the HRIS to automate offer letter generation and background-check triggers.

At Covalent Infotech I led Recruitment for technical and product teams, designing role-specific interview templates and scorecards maintained in Confluence. I established a high-touch Onboarding program for lateral hires that improved new-hire ramp time and retention in the first 6 months. I partnered with engineering managers in Agile hiring cycles, using Jira to track open positions and candidate stages. I maintained the HRIS candidate database and ran weekly Talent Acquisition reports for leadership.
